ideas.pitch: A defense-in-depth security proxy specifically tailored for testing and hardening LLM-powered applications against zero-day prompt injections and automated extraction flags.
ideas.title: PromptShield CTF Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly applies winning patterns from agent hardening challenges and appeals heavily to a technical CTF audience looking for advanced automated vulnerability scanners.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge proof verification circuit that allows players to prove they have solved a cryptography CTF challenge without revealing the actual flag to intermediate relay servers.
ideas.title: CryptoCTF Zero-Knowledge Flag Verifier
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages complex ZK engineering patterns that consistently impress technical judges who value cryptographic correctness and novel protocol design.

ideas.pitch: An automated binary analysis and risk-investigation tool that parses compiled CTF binaries into function call graphs and runs graph intelligence to flag obfuscation and shellcode patterns.
ideas.title: MalwarePattern Graph-Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hard systems investigation with graph-based intelligence similar to winning anti-money laundering risk detection platforms.

ideas.pitch: A signal processing tool designed to solve CTF forensics challenges involving hidden data transmitted via audio steganography, modulated acoustic signals, or RF static.
ideas.title: Acoustic Exfiltration Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Taps into unusual physical and signal-processing builds that stand out from typical web-based CTF helper scripts.

ideas.pitch: A fine-tuned transformer model optimized specifically to parse through massive OSINT and email-dump CTF challenges to automatically detect phishing headers, social engineering indicators, and hidden text flags.
ideas.title: BERT-Powered Phishing Flag Extractor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors winning runner-up architectures that use NLP classification to automate tedious manual investigations during cyber competitions.
